title: Even after 3 years living in Barcelona, Crown Tours managed to surprise me!
text:
I joined their tapas bar tour and absolutely loved it! I’ve been living in Barcelona for three years, but even after all this time, the experience was still so interesting. I discovered new places I had never been to before and learned more about the local food culture.

If you’re visiting Barcelona for the first time, I 100% recommend taking this tour! It’s such a fun way to discover the city and experience its gastronomy. ❤️
author: I7149PCsvetlanas

title: Great tastes and guide
text: The experience was exceptional… Our guy Roberto was fabulous, entertaining and informative. All the places we went to had plenty of serving size for tastings and samplings. Would definitely do this to Work again with this guide.
author: bep0803

title: Great overview of the old town as well as tapas and wine!
text: We were sold this tour while we were waiting to go on the tour of the Parc Güell. A last minute decision that we were all pleased we made. We learned a lot about the history of Barcelona and saw lots of interesting things, aside from the bars we visited for the tapas and drinks. The guide (David) was great and it was good to meet the other members of the (small) tour.
author: playtheblues

title: Highly recommend
text: I was hesitant at first as I'm a big wine and foodie and thought this might be cheesy. I couldn't recommend it enough. Our guide was fantastic and it was more than just a food and tapas tour. We learned so much history about the area, went to about four different places wandered around and saw things I would not have seen on my own and the group of people were lovely. Our tour guide David was top notch. He was super fun and we loved every second of it.
author: nicolacK4352WJ

title: Welcome to the neighborhood!
text: Unique experience. We felt we were locals enjoying the best of the neighborhood. Roberto shared not only a great tasting experience but also shared vast knowledge of the history of the area.
author: JettlAAg

title: Tapas and history guide in Barcelona
text: We had a very good time. Our group was very small, which made the tour feel so much more intimate and we got to learn a lot about the history of the city, along with finding amazing eateries off the beaten track. Our guide Carmelo was amazing. So keen to share the local traditions and hidden gems. We would definitely recommend.
